description: A versioned list of cards, as a file `debate-research verify` can check.

manifest_version.description: The manifest format version. A reader refuses a version it does not know.
manifest_version.title: Manifest Version

cards.description: The cards, each the domain Card exactly as it serializes (card.schema.json).
cards.title: Cards

snapshots.description: From version 2: the snapshots the cards were cut from, once each, in snapshot id order. Ids and hashes only, never a snapshot's text. Absent from a version 1 manifest.

items.description: A stored snapshot, named by id and hash: what a manifest says about it, and never its text.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes retrieved.
sha256.title: Sha256

normalized_text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalized text, UTF-8, no BOM.
normalized_text_hash.title: Normalized Text Hash

normalizer_version.description: The normalizer version the text was produced under.
normalizer_version.title: Normalizer Version

extractor_version.description: The extractor version the text was produced under.
extractor_version.title: Extractor Version

retrieved_at.description: When the retrieval happened, in UTC.
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

canonical_url.description: The URL actually retrieved, after redirects.
canonical_url.title: Canonical Url

items.title: SnapshotReference

snapshots.title: Snapshots
